title: President Trump presents National Medals of Science and Technology
excerpt: Six innovators received the honors during the Science: A New Golden Age Summit on October 8, 2026.
bodyHtml:
On October 8, 2026, President Donald J. Trump presented the National Medal of Science and the National Medal of Technology and Innovation to six individuals. The White House stated these honors recognize exemplary achievement and leadership in science and technology.

The recipients of the National Medal of Science are Elon Musk, Sergey Brin, Jensen Huang, and Lisa Su. Michael Dell and Satya Nadella received the National Medal of Technology and Innovation. According to the White House, these medalists have pioneered breakthroughs in science and engineering for the new age of super intelligence, including advances in general-purpose parallel computing and semiconductor design.

The awards were presented at the Science: A New Golden Age Summit. The summit convenes leading scientists and innovators to examine changes in scientific discovery and discuss the implementation of the report titled Science: A New Golden Age, which was released in July 2026 by White House Office of Science and Technology Policy Director Michael Kratsios.
